title: VA Outpatient Clinic - Charleston, SC - Request for Lease Proposals
office: VA Office of Construction & Facilities Management
description: The Department of Veterans Affairs requires approximately 33,000 to 35,000 rentable square feet (RSF), yielding an ANSI/BOMA Office Area (ABOA) square footage of approximately 30,000 square feet, of clinical outpatient space in Charleston, South Carolina. The Government requires a firm term of fifteen (15) years, with a total term not to exceed twenty (20) years including options. Offers are due per the attached RLP.

title: GSA - FBI Field Office - Advertisement for Lease
description: GSA, on behalf of the Federal Bureau of Investigation, is seeking expressions of interest for approximately 45,000 ABOA square feet of secure office space. Firm term of 10 years is required, full term 20 years. See attached advertisement for full security and site requirements.

title: SSA - Small Field Office Lease - Under Threshold
description: SSA requires approximately 6,500 ABOA square feet of field office space. Firm term of 10 years, full term 20 years.

title: DHS - Short Term Space Request
description: DHS requires approximately 20,000 rentable square feet. Firm term of 5 years with options to extend.
